row.evidence: Material syncs every account from the connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 tenant ("User accounts will sync shortly and appear in Material in the Explorer") and offers SAML Admin SSO; no SCIM endpoint appears on the pricing page, docs index or API v1 reference.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5). Material is an email/workspace security product: its accounts are the customer's Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 mailboxes, pulled in by Material's own API connection to the tenant (vendor-run directory sync), with licences auto-assigned to new accounts. Admin roles are not inherited from the email provider; they are assigned to synced accounts or groups in Material or via API v1. Admin console sign-in uses a custom SAML app in Google, Entra or Okta; the docs do not tie Admin SSO to a plan, so sso_plan is null. Okta integration (API token) syncs Okta groups and MFA status for detections, not users. Pricing: Essentials $4 and Advanced $6 per user/month billed annually, each plus a Shared Drive fee; ATO Resilience +$3 add-on or $5 stand-alone; Enterprise Talk to Sales. API v1 (Accounts, Groups, Roles) and Event Subscriptions are on both Essentials and Advanced.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the pricing page, the docs llms.txt index (all ~190 pages fetched and searched for 'scim' and 'provisioning') or API v1 reference. false is by absence (rule 5). Accounts come from Material's own Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 sync.

auth.notes: Per-account API token in the x-material-client-secret header; requests run with the token owner's current role permissions.

capabilities.notes: Accounts and groups are read-only mirrors of the Google/Microsoft/Okta directory: only VIP, licences, settings and roles are writable, so create/deactivate/delete are false. manage_groups means updating group licences, settings and roles, not membership.

endpoints.purpose: Update VIP, licences, setting overrides and role assignments
Update group licences, settings and roles

audit_log_api.notes: An in-app Audit Log exists (c22) and audit events can feed Event Subscriptions, but no audit-log API endpoint is documented in API v1.

rate_limits.text: Rate limited per instance; bursts return 429 Too Many Requests (no numeric limit published).

limitations.text: Identity, mailbox and provider fields are synced from Google/Microsoft and read-only through the API.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/material-security/ and /material/ return 404. Material documents Okta as a custom SAML app for Admin SSO and an API-token integration that syncs Okta groups; neither creates Material accounts.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial (not in the saas-apps TOC). Accounts sync from the connected Microsoft 365 tenant (vendor-run), recorded as directory_sync in row.idp; Admin SSO uses a custom Entra SAML app.

google.notes: Accounts sync from the connected Google Workspace tenant (vendor-run), recorded as directory_sync in row.idp; Admin SSO uses a custom Google SAML app.

fallbacks.other_sync: Vendor-run sync of all accounts and groups from the connected Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 tenant (plus Okta groups via API token); licences auto-assigned to new accounts
